annotations.title: Chart price trends of developments or areas

description: Use this instead of get_price_trend when the user asks to chart, plot or graph how prices at up to 4 Singapore developments, HDB streets or towns, or postal districts moved, such as "Chart prices at The Sail against Marina One since 2018". Takes the same subjects and years as get_price_trend and draws its median S$ psf by quarter as a line chart, one line per subject, with thin quarters (fewer than 3 sales) and the unfinished current quarter drawn hollow, and each line linked to the Homejourney page that charts it. Also returns the same quarters, sales counts and page links as text, so quote them and cite the pages when the host cannot show the chart.
name: render_price_trend_chart
title: Chart price trends of developments or areas
